fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-04-09, around 08:40, the email and banking application of Abirami Sekar were accessed without permission after an OTP was shared during a call, and Rs. 15,000 was moved out, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-04-14. Dharani Prakash (9000000213) reported the matter for Abirami Sekar, whose contact number is given as 9000000186. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Vasanth Gopal, using the number 9000000245. A witness, Amudha Kannan, reachable on 9000000066, was mentioned in the complaint. The account reference SYN-ACC-100051 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: OTP allegedly obtained during a call before the account was accessed.
fields.Keywords: account takeover, unauthorised access, witness, screenshot, transaction record, mobile number, college road, morning
